method.full_document: All 151 pages were rendered with Poppler at 120 dpi and inspected sequentially.
method.contact_sheets: Nineteen contact sheets covering all 151 pages were inspected in sequence.
method.high_resolution: The cover, abstract, table of contents, cardinal theorem, alpha sections, figures, conclusions, and references were inspected at 240 dpi.
method.heading_scan: Every numbered heading was checked for isolation, widow placement, and available space below the heading.
method.geometry: The full raster set was checked for uniform dimensions, blank pages, clipping, overflow, edge contact, and anomalous render bounds.
method.font_check: All seven fonts are embedded, subset, and Unicode-mapped.

notes: The cover uses the technical title Resolution of the Continuum Hypothesis in the Holographic Genealogical Closure.
The introduction closes cleanly on page 4; Contents begins on page 5 and occupies pages 5-6.
The previously detected widow/carryover page was eliminated without removing or altering content.
Figures remain vectorial, sharp, ordered, and wholly inside the page margins.
Pages 26, 38, 67, 68, 72, 94, and 96 are intentionally more open because of proof closure, figure placement, or section transition; none is a defect.
The conclusions and references are complete and typographically stable.
scope: Visual and typographic verification only; mathematical correctness and causal provenance are controlled by separate gates and receipts.
